fields.body:
## Usage Guide

1. Add or update viewer-api rules under `viewer-api/.rule/rules/**`.
2. Preview the local README target with `rule explain-target --config rule-targets.yaml --target viewer-api-readme`.
3. Regenerate the README with `rule sync-targets --config rule-targets.yaml`.
4. Keep parent-facing summaries in this workspace so memory-viewers can compose them by repo scope.
